</a>

            </h1>

            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3446468/202603/3446468-20260318163257890-1440618907.png" alt="通义深度搜索-生成对话" class="desc_img">
        基于智能体应用管理提供的 agent_id 与 agent_version 信息，提供场景化对话、研究、写作相关能力。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p><strong>产品链接</strong></p>
<p><a href="https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/tongyi-deep-search-introduction?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-2400256.d_1_12_15_0.5a87381fQvqbj7&amp;scm=20140722.H_2983662._.OR_help-T_cn~zh-V_1" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">面向深度的查询问答和调研分析需求场景,多步骤推理规划研究路径,生成有洞察、可溯源、图文并茂的长文报告-大模型服务平台百炼(Model&nbsp;Studio)-阿里云帮助中心</a></p>
<hr>
<p>本产品（<a href="https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/?spm=a2ty02.31808181.d_app-market.1.6c4974a1tFmoFc&amp;tab=app#/app/app-market/deep-search/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><strong>通义深度搜索</strong></a>）对外服务接口目录。所有接口使用&nbsp;DashScope&nbsp;HTTP&nbsp;协议对外提供服务。</p>
<p>基于智能体应用管理提供的&nbsp;agent_id&nbsp;与&nbsp;agent_version&nbsp;信息，提供场景化对话、研究、写作相关能力。</p>
<h2 id="请求语法">请求语法</h2>
<pre><code class="language-plaintext">POST /deep-search-agent/chat/completions HTTP/1.1
</code></pre>
<h2 id="请求参数">请求参数</h2>

<thead>
<tr>

</tr>

<td>object</td>

<td>str</td>

<td>output.choices</td>

<td>是</td>

<td>output.choices.[].finish_reason</td>
<td>str</td>
<td>是</td>

</tr>

<td>output.choices.[].message</td>
<td>object</td>

<td>output.choices.[].message.content</td>
<td>str&nbsp;|&nbsp;array[object]</td>
<td>是</td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td>output.choices.[].message.reasoning_content</td>
<td>str</td>
<td>否</td>
<td>思考内容，如果&nbsp;content内没有内容，则尝试获取最后一轮深度思考中的reasoning_content内容</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>output.choices.[].message.tool_calls</td>
<td>array[object]</td>
<td>否</td>
<td>工具调用信息</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>output.choices.[].message.tool_calls[0].arguments</td>
<td>dcit[str,object]</td>
<td>否</td>
<td>工具调用参数</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>output.choices.[].message.tool_calls[0].name</td>
<td>str</td>
<td>否</td>
<td>工具调用名称</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>output.choices.[].message.additional_kwargs.extra_json</td>
<td>Any</td>
<td>否</td>
<td>工具调用返回时，携带结构化输出信息</td>
</tr>
<tr>

<td>dict</td>
<td>否</td>
<td>步骤状态信息</td>

<tr>

<h3 id="计划枚举">计划枚举</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th><strong>执行阶段（</strong><code>**group**</code><strong>）</strong></th>
<th><strong>描述</strong></th>
<th><strong>说明</strong></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>planning</td>
<td>计划中</td>
<td>对应plan模型，即系统处于任务规划阶段，该阶段包含&nbsp;start&nbsp;和&nbsp;end&nbsp;事件</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>generating</td>
<td>生成中</td>
<td>表示为写作模型，表示系统正处于报告生成阶段，此阶段不区分详细事件变化，无&nbsp;start/end&nbsp;事件；step&nbsp;状态仅包括&nbsp;thinking&nbsp;和&nbsp;generating，且不会调用工具。</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th><strong>当前步骤（</strong><code>**step**</code><strong>）</strong></th>
<th><strong>描述和说明</strong></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>planning</td>
<td>计划中</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>thinking</td>
<td>思考中</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>reporting</td>
<td>总结中（法律场景特有）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>generating</td>
<td>生成中</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>tool_calling</td>
<td>工具调用中</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>tool_calling_</td>
<td>工具调用中，附带工具名称</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<ul>
<li>
<p>由于模型原因&nbsp;step_change&nbsp;值可能为不存在，请尽可能使用持久化的标志step</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>空包情况下&nbsp;step、step_change、group&nbsp;字段的值可能不存在</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>plan、think、generation&nbsp;均由&nbsp;xxx_start&nbsp;事件&nbsp;和&nbsp;xxx_end&nbsp;事件两个事件组成</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>tool_call&nbsp;由&nbsp;tool_call_start、tool_calling、tool_return&nbsp;三个事件组成</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>tool_call_start&nbsp;表示工具调用开始（开始流式收集工具调用信息，此时还无法吐出工具调用详情（name、args等））、tool_calling&nbsp;表示获取到完整工具调用的参数并会抛出完整的工具调用参数tool_return&nbsp;表示工具调用返回结果，同时会携带结构化的工具返回信息。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th><strong>步骤变化事件&nbsp;(</strong><code>**step_change**</code><strong>)</strong></th>
<th><strong>事件发生时</strong>&nbsp;<code>**step**</code>&nbsp;<strong>的值</strong></th>
<th><strong>事件名称</strong></th>
<th><strong>解释说明</strong></th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>plan_start</td>
<td><code>planning</code></td>
<td>开始规划</td>
<td><code>step</code>&nbsp;状态变为&nbsp;<code>planning</code>,&nbsp;表示对应状态的开头（包含当前包）。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>plan_end</td>
<td><code>planning</code></td>
<td>结束规划</td>
<td><code>step</code>&nbsp;开始变成其他状态，事件发生时&nbsp;<code>step</code>&nbsp;仍为&nbsp;<code>planning</code>，表示对应状态的结尾（包含当前包）。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>think_start</td>
<td><code>thinking</code></td>
<td>开始思考</td>
<td>与&nbsp;<code>plan</code>&nbsp;事件同理</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>think_end</td>
<td><code>thinking</code></td>
<td>结束思考</td>
<td>与&nbsp;<code>plan</code>&nbsp;事件同理</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>report_start</td>
<td><code>reporting</code></td>
<td>开始总结</td>
<td>与&nbsp;<code>plan</code>&nbsp;事件同理</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>report_end</td>
<td><code>reporting</code></td>
<td>结束总结</td>
<td>与&nbsp;<code>plan</code>&nbsp;事件同理</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>generation_start</td>
<td><code>generating</code></td>
<td>开始生成</td>
<td>与&nbsp;<code>plan</code>&nbsp;事件同理</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>generation_end</td>
<td><code>generating</code></td>
<td>结束生成</td>
<td>与&nbsp;<code>plan</code>&nbsp;事件同理</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>tool_call_start</td>
<td><code>tool_calling</code></td>
<td>开始工具调用</td>
<td>表示工具调用开始（开始流式收集工具调用信息，此时还无法吐出工具调用详情（name、arguments等））。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>tool_calling</td>
<td><code>tool_calling_{工具名称}</code></td>
<td>工具调用中</td>
<td>会输出tool_call的具体参数和工具名称，<code>tool_calling</code>状态变为<code>tool_calling_{工具名称}</code>。</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>tool_return</td>
<td><code>tool_calling_{工具名称}</code></td>
<td>工具返回</td>
<td>会携带工具返回信息，&nbsp;<code>step</code>&nbsp;开始变成其他状态，事件发生时&nbsp;<code>step</code>&nbsp;仍为&nbsp;<code>tool_calling_{工具名称}</code>。</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2 id="示例">示例</h2>
<h3 id="请求示例">请求示例</h3>
<pre><code class="language-plaintext">{
    "input": {
        "messages": [
            {
                "role": "user", 
                "content": "现在日期"
            }
        ]
    },
    "parameters": {
        "agent_options": {
            "agent_id": "aid-xxx",
            "agent_version": "beta"
        }
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="返回示例">返回示例</h3>
<pre><code class="language-plaintext">data: {
    "code": "200",
    "message": "",
    "output": {
        "choices": [{
            "finish_reason": "",
            "message": {
                "content": "",
                "additional_kwargs": {},
                "response_metadata": {},
                "tool_calls": [],
                "reasoning_content": "",
                "role": "assistant",
                "extra": {
                    "group": "planning",
                    "step_change": "think_start",
                    "step": "thinking"
                }
            }
        }]
    },
    "usage": null,
    "request_id": "5b853312-8d0c-42ff-9d26-08339d5ff38e"
}
</code></pre>
<p>当生成配置开启输出报告时，模型尾包会给出&nbsp;html&nbsp;和&nbsp;md&nbsp;的存储地址和路径，content&nbsp;中&nbsp;type&nbsp;的含义参考如下</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>file_path：文件存储路径用于后续导出pdf和二次获取以下文件下载链接</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>md_file_url：md下载链接</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>html_file_url：html下载链接</p>
</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-plaintext">{
  "status_code": 200,
  "code": "",
  "message": "",
  "output": {
    "choices": [
      {
        "finish_reason": "stop", 
        "message": {
          "content": [
            {
              "type": "file_path", 
              "text": "msearch/agents/files/upload/536fa835-a381-4870-99c1-79dee3ab946c"
            },
            {
              "type": "md_file_url", 
              "text": "https://msearch-cloud.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/msearch/agents/files/upload/536fa835-a381-4870-99c1-79dee3ab946c.md?x-oss-signature-version=OSS4-HMAC-SHA256&amp;x-oss-date=20250904T151053Z&amp;x-oss-expires=900&amp;x-oss-credential=LTAI5tCLjk1ruCfq2caq****%2F20250904%2Fcn-hangzhou%2Foss%2Faliyun_v4_request&amp;x-oss-signature=9f9af4642f3611b1b8210bd801f10610236656a016e6bda67e2239ecf59b644f"
            },
            {
              "type": "html_file_url", 
              "text": "https://msearch-cloud.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/msearch/agents/files/upload/536fa835-a381-4870-99c1-79dee3ab946c.html?x-oss-signature-version=OSS4-HMAC-SHA256&amp;x-oss-date=20250904T151053Z&amp;x-oss-expires=900&amp;x-oss-credential=LTAI5tCLjk1ruCfq2caq****%2F20250904%2Fcn-hangzhou%2Foss%2Faliyun_v4_request&amp;x-oss-signature=34164425671a0f26a39adacd12735d9ec127aec8caa68f8e1de6e252f5889a9c"
            }
          ],
          "additional_kwargs": {},
          "response_metadata": {
            "model_name": "deep-research-generation",
            "agent_name": "writing_agent"
          },
          "tool_calls": [],
          "reasoning_content": "",
          "role": "assistant"
        }
      }
    ]
  },
  "usage": null,
  "request_id": "3070fa78-c5d5-4bad-b2fc-e20787f6eb75"
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="调用示例">调用示例</h2>
<p>Python示例:</p>
<pre><code class="language-plaintext"># coding=utf-8

import os
import json
import requests

split_line = "\n-------------------------------------生成报告链接---------------------------------------------------\n"

chat_completions_url = 'https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/api/v2/apps/deep-search-agent/chat/completions'

headers = {
    'Authorization': f'Bearer {os.getenv("DASHSCOPE_API_KEY", "")}',  # 配置 API KEY
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    params = {
        "input": {
            "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "目前国内主流多模态模型分别有哪些，根据性能和效果做下评估"}]  # 传入请求消息
        },
        "parameters": {
            "agent_options": {  # 设置 agent 选项
                "agent_id": "${agent_id}",  # 应用ID，可在应用管理页面获取到，例如：aid-8fd***e00
                "agent_version": "${agent_version}"  # 应用版本，beta 测试版本 / release 发布版本
            }
        },
        "stream": True
    }
    
    response = requests.post(chat_completions_url, headers=headers, json=params, stream=True)
    
    resultlist = []
    stage = ''
    action = ''
    content = ''
    reasoning_content = ''
    for chunk in response.iter_lines():
        if chunk:
            chunk_str = chunk.decode('utf-8').strip()
            if chunk_str.startswith('data:'):
                json_str = chunk_str[len('data:'):].strip()
                try:
                    obj = json.loads(json_str)
                    # 检查异常
                    if obj.get('code') != '200':
                        print("服务异常：", obj)
                    # 获取消息体
                    msg = obj.get('output', {}).get('choices', [{}])[0].get('message', {})
                    extra_flags = msg.get('extra', {})  # 获取模型状态标记字段
    
                    if stage != extra_flags.get('group', ''):  # 获取 模型当前阶段
                        print(f"agent stage: {extra_flags.get('group', '')}")
                    stage = extra_flags.get('group', '')
    
                    if action != extra_flags.get('step', '') and extra_flags.get('step', ''):  # 获取 模型当前阶段
                        print(f"agent action: {extra_flags.get('step', '')}")
                    action = extra_flags.get('step', '')
    
                    role = msg.get('role', '')  # 获取模型角色 assistant or role
                    content = msg.get('content')  # 获取生成内容
                    toolcalls = msg.get('tool_calls', [])  # 获取工具调用
                    if toolcalls:
                        print(f'{toolcalls}')
    
                    if not content:  # 如果 content内没有内容，则尝试获取最后一轮深度思考中的reasoning_content内容
                        content = msg.get('reasoning_content', '')
    
                    if isinstance(content, str):
                        if role == "tool":
                            print("\n" + content + "\n", end='')  # 前后都换行
                        else:
                            print(content, end='')  # 流式输出
                    else:
                        # 注意 content 可能不是字符串
                        print(split_line, content)
                    # 可按需保存
                    resultlist.append(obj)
                except Exception as e:
                    print("异常解析:", e)
</code></pre>
<p>java示例:</p>
<pre><code class="language-plaintext">import java.io.*;
import java.net.*;
import java.util.*;
import com.alibaba.fastjson.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;


public class DeepSearchStreamDemo {

    // 配置 API KEY
    public final static String CHAT_COMPLETIONS_URL = "https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/api/v2/apps/deep-search-agent/chat/completions";
    public final static String API_KEY = System.getenv("DASHSCOPE_API_KEY");


    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        // 构造参数
        Map&lt;String, Object&gt; params = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
        // input.messages
        List&lt;Map&lt;String, Object&gt;&gt; messages = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();
        Map&lt;String, Object&gt; msgObj = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
        msgObj.put("role", "user");
        msgObj.put("content", "${prompt}");
        messages.add(msgObj);
        // input
        Map&lt;String, Object&gt; input = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
        input.put("messages", messages);
        // parameters.agent_options
        Map&lt;String, Object&gt; agentOptions = new HashMap&lt;&gt;(); // 
        agentOptions.put("agent_id", "${agent_id}");// 应用ID，可在应用管理页面获取到，例如：aid-8fd***e00
        agentOptions.put("agent_version", "${agent_version}"); // 应用版本，beta 测试版本 / release 发布版本
        // parameters
        Map&lt;String, Object&gt; parameters = new HashMap&lt;&gt;();
        parameters.put("agent_options", agentOptions);

        params.put("input", input);
        params.put("parameters", parameters);
        params.put("stream", true);

        String body = JSON.toJSONString(params);

        // HTTP 请求
        URL apiUrl = new URL(CHAT_COMPLETIONS_URL);
        HttpURLConnection conn = (HttpURLConnection) apiUrl.openConnection();
        conn.setRequestMethod("POST");
        conn.setDoOutput(true);
        conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " + API_KEY);
        conn.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json");

        // 发送 body
        try (OutputStream os = conn.getOutputStream()) {
            os.write(body.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        }

        // 处理流式响应
        InputStream inputStream = conn.getInputStream();
        BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(inputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        String line;
        String stage = "";
        String action = "";
        List&lt;JSONObject&gt; resultList = new ArrayList&lt;&gt;();

        while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
            if (!line.trim().isEmpty()) {
                String chunkStr = line.trim();
                if (chunkStr.startsWith("data:")) {
                    String jsonStr = chunkStr.substring(5).trim();
                    try {
                        JSONObject obj = JSON.parseObject(jsonStr);
                        // 检查异常
                        if (!"200".equals(obj.getString("code"))) {
                            System.out.print("服务异常: " + obj);
                        }
                        // 获取  output-&gt;choices[0]-&gt;message
                        JSONObject msg = null;
                        if (obj.containsKey("output")) {
                            JSONObject output = obj.getJSONObject("output");
                            if (output != null &amp;&amp; output.containsKey("choices")) {
                                JSONArray choices = output.getJSONArray("choices");
                                if (choices != null &amp;&amp; !choices.isEmpty()) {
                                    JSONObject firstChoice = choices.getJSONObject(0);
                                    if (firstChoice.containsKey("message")) {
                                        msg = firstChoice.getJSONObject("message");
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (msg == null) {
                            continue;
                        }

                        // 获取 extra_flags 字段
                        JSONObject extraFlags = msg.containsKey("extra") &amp;&amp; msg.get("extra") != null
                                ? msg.getJSONObject("extra") : new JSONObject();

                        // agent stage
                        String stageNew = extraFlags.containsKey("group") &amp;&amp; extraFlags.get("group") != null
                                ? extraFlags.getString("group") : "";
                        if (!stage.equals(stageNew)) {
                            System.out.println("agent stage: " + stageNew);
                        }
                        stage = stageNew;

                        // agent action
                        String actionNew = extraFlags.containsKey("step") &amp;&amp; extraFlags.get("step") != null
                                ? extraFlags.getString("step") : "";
                        if (!action.equals(actionNew) &amp;&amp; !actionNew.isEmpty()) {
                            System.out.println("agent action: " + actionNew);
                        }
                        action = actionNew;

                        String role = msg.containsKey("role") &amp;&amp; msg.get("role") != null
                                ? msg.getString("role") : "";

                        Object contentObj = msg.get("content");
                        String content = null;
                        boolean isContentString = false;
                        // content 是字符串类型
                        if (contentObj instanceof String) {
                            content = contentObj.toString();
                            isContentString = true;
                        }

                        // 字符串为空时补 reasoning_content
                        if (isContentString &amp;&amp; content.isEmpty()) {
                            Object reasoningContentObj = msg.get("reasoning_content");
                            if (reasoningContentObj instanceof String) {
                                content = reasoningContentObj.toString();
                            }
                        }

                        // 工具调用
                        if (msg.containsKey("tool_calls") &amp;&amp; msg.get("tool_calls") instanceof List) {
                            JSONArray toolCalls = msg.getJSONArray("tool_calls");
                            if (!toolCalls.isEmpty()) {
                                System.out.println(toolCalls);
                            }
                        }

                        // -------输出内容判断--------
                        if (isContentString) {
                            // 是字符串，无论空不空都直接打印（和Python一致）
                            if ("tool".equals(role)) {
                                System.out.print("\n" + content + "\n");
                            } else {
                                System.out.print(content);
                            }
                        } else {
                            // 不是字符串（比如Object/Array）时打印分隔线，再打印内容
                            System.out.println("\n------------------------------------------------------------------生成报告链接------------------------------------------------------------------");
                            System.out.println(contentObj != null ? contentObj.toString() : "null");
                        }
                        // ------end----

                        // 可按需保存
                        resultList.add(obj);
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        System.out.println("异常解析: " + e);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        reader.close();
    }
}
</code></pre>
